name: Hats Off (manual): a cutscene hides the hat from start to end, no flicker

steps.msg: precondition: Glamourer connected, Hats Off on and idle

steps.mark: START THE CUTSCENE NOW (Inn: Unending Journey, or a quest step)

steps.msg: a cutscene should start within 2 minutes and Hats Off should hide the hat
the hat should actually disappear (precondition: wearing headgear that is shown)

steps.mark: cutscene playing: watch the hat stay off (also on the cutscene copy of your character)

steps.msg: after the cutscene (max 7 minutes) Hats Off should restore the hat (delay 0.5 s by default)
the cutscene should really be over
no hat flicker (start, scene changes, end)
no warnings or errors from Hats Off
